# robotInverseDynamicsTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [robotInverseDynamicsTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/robotInverseDynamicsTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The inverse dynamics of a Robot of exudyn.robotics and the dynamic compensation of its control (#3276):
#           KinematicChain.InverseDynamics (C++, recursive Newton-Euler) and Robot.InverseDynamics (Python) agree, at
#           zero velocity and acceleration they are the negative of the static torques, and they equal M q_tt + the
#           left-hand side of the ODE2 equations of an ObjectKinematicTree of the same robot - for revolute joints about
#           x, y and z and prismatic joints, at random states. The Staubli TX2-90L follows a fast trajectory with
#           Robot.SetControl and PreStepControl, in the kinematic tree and in the redundant coordinate model: with
#           compensation='dynamic' the tracking error is less than a tenth of that with 'static', the same in both
#           models. The result is the number of checks that pass plus the tracking errors. Run directly, the
#           SolutionViewer shows the kinematic tree with compensation='dynamic'.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-05
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.itemInterface import ObjectGround, MarkerBodyRigid
from exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities import InertiaCuboid
from exudyn.robotics import Robot, RobotLink
from exudyn.robotics.models import ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L, ManipulatorPuma560, LinkDict2Robot
from exudyn.robotics.motion import Trajectory, ProfilePolynomial5
import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)
OVT = exu.OutputVariableType
checks = []
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)

def ThreeLinks(jointTypes):
    """a robot of three links with the joint types, COMs off the axes"""
    robot = Robot(gravity=[0, 0, -9.81])
    inertia = InertiaCuboid(density=1000, sideLengths=[0.1, 0.15, 0.4])
    for (jointType, preHT) in zip(jointTypes, [exu.HT(), exu.HT(translation=[0.2, 0, 0.3]), exu.HT(translation=[0, 0.1, 0.2])]):
        robot.AddLink(RobotLink(mass=inertia.Mass(), COM=[0.05, 0.02, 0.1], inertia=inertia.InertiaCOM(), jointType=jointType, preHT=preHT))
    return robot

def TreeForces(robot, q, q_t, q_tt):
    """M q_tt + the left-hand side of the ODE2 equations of the kinematic tree of robot at q, q_t"""
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    tree = robot.CreateKinematicTree(mbs)
    mbs.Assemble()
    solver = exu.MainSolverImplicitSecondOrder()
    solver.InitializeSolver(mbs, exu.SimulationSettings())
    mbs.systemData.SetODE2Coordinates(q - robot.referenceConfiguration, configuration=exu.ConfigurationType.Current)
    mbs.systemData.SetODE2Coordinates_t(q_t, configuration=exu.ConfigurationType.Current)
    solver.ComputeMassMatrix(mbs)
    return solver.GetSystemMassMatrix() @ q_tt + mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(tree['objectKinematicTree'], OVT.Force)

for robot in [ThreeLinks(['Rz', 'Ry', 'Rx']), ThreeLinks(['Rz', 'Pz', 'Rx']), ThreeLinks(['Px', 'Py', 'Pz']),
              LinkDict2Robot(ManipulatorPuma560())]:
    for link in robot.links:
        link.PDcontrol = (0., 0.) #the tree without control forces
    chain = robot.GetKinematicChain()
    n = len(robot.links)
    (q, q_t, q_tt) = rng.uniform(-1, 1, (3, n))
    tau = chain.InverseDynamics(q, q_t, q_tt)
    scale = np.max(np.abs(tau))
    checks += [np.max(np.abs(tau - robot.InverseDynamics(q, q_t, q_tt))) < 1e-12*scale]
    checks += [np.max(np.abs(chain.InverseDynamics(q, 0*q, 0*q) + chain.StaticTorques(q))) < 1e-12*scale]
    checks += [np.max(np.abs(tau - TreeForces(robot, q, q_t, q_tt))) < 1e-10*scale]

#the dynamic compensation of the control of the TX2-90L, in both models
q0 = np.array([0, 0.5, 1.4, 0, 1.2, 0])
q1 = np.array([0.8, 0.2, 1.7, 0.5, 0.9, -0.5])
errors = {}
for model in ['tree', 'redundant']:
    for compensation in ['static', 'dynamic']:
        robot = LinkDict2Robot(ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L())
        robot.q0 = q0
        trajectory = Trajectory(q0)
        trajectory.Add(ProfilePolynomial5(q1, 0.6))
        SC = exu.SystemContainer()
        mbs = SC.AddSystem()
        if model == 'tree':
            robot.CreateKinematicTree(mbs)
        else:
            oGround = mbs.AddObject(ObjectGround())
            robot.CreateRedundantCoordinateMBS(mbs, mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=oGround)))
        robot.SetControl(trajectory, compensation=compensation)
        sensors = robot.AddSensors(mbs, [OVT.Coordinates])
        mbs.SetPreStepUserFunction(robot.PreStepControl)
        mbs.Assemble()
        simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
        simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 300
        simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.6
        simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
        show = not testIsActive and model == 'tree' and compensation == 'dynamic'
        simulationSettings.solution.file.write = show #for the SolutionViewer
        simulationSettings.solution.sensors.writePeriod = 0.002
        mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
        if show:
            mbs.SolutionViewer()
        data = mbs.GetSensorStoredData(sensors[OVT.Coordinates])
        errors[(model, compensation)] = max(np.max(np.abs(row[1:] - trajectory.Evaluate(row[0])[0])) for row in data)
exu.Print('tracking errors:', errors)
checks += [errors[('tree', 'dynamic')] < 0.1*errors[('tree', 'static')]]
checks += [abs(errors[('tree', 'dynamic')] - errors[('redundant', 'dynamic')]) < 1e-6]

u = sum(checks) + errors[('tree', 'static')] + errors[('tree', 'dynamic')]
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of robotInverseDynamicsTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
